text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While out shopping with Kawakami Princess 
in the shopping district—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Step right up, the New Year's Grand Raffle 
is underway~! The grand prize is an 
all-expenses-paid hot springs trip!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
1st prize is the "Special Carrot Hamburg 
Steak"! 2nd prize is "Mountain of 
Carrots"! 3rd prize is "Single Carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
"Step right up, step right up, it's the 
fun, fun lottery! Anyone and everyone, 
come on over!"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Urk, the raffle...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, I should have 
received one lottery ticket when I went 
shopping earlier.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Ugh... uuu... old memories are flooding 
back...!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
I remember trying so hard to win the 1st 
prize PreFy Phone, and ending up with a 
whole mountain of tissues...!
choice_data_list:
Let's rewrite those memories with this 
single shot!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Guh. But the greedier one gets, the more 
likely one is to draw a blank...
choice_data_list:
It's okay, the Purify Phone isn't one of 
the prizes

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ...I see.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Understood. Today's the day I win 
something other than tissues! Here I go!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And together with Kawakami Princess, I 
turn the raffle crank.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And the result was—

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Incredible! Congraaaatulations!! The Grand 
Prize, 'Hot Springs Trip Ticket', has been 
won~~~~!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: It's heeeere!!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"Did you see that, Trainer?! I won the 
grand prize!!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Kawakami Princess jumped for joy. If I let 
her keep the prize as well, it would 
become an even better memory for her...

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Now it's time for us to head off on a 
hot spring trip together!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ? ...Is that not it?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Because this grand prize was won through 
the power of our bond, Trainer-san! If 
we're going to enjoy it, I want us to do 
it together!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Hot spriiings♪ Hot spriiings♪

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
...Leaving her dancing with joy, I checked 
the schedule in my hand. If we were to go 
together, I'd need to match a full day off 
with hers.
choice_data_list:
It looks like it'll still be a while, is 
that okay?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Of course! Hot springsâª Hot springsâª

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
She was completely overjoyed by the hot 
springs. Her face, which had been 
unusually stiff lately, softened with a 
smile during this moment alone.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations, you won 1st prize~! The 
prize is a "Special Carrot Hamburg Steak"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ...1st prize!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
This is... victory through pure 
selflessness...! I have finally won 1st 
place...!!

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Yes! Here's your prize, the "Special 
Deluxe Carrot Hamburg Steak"!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Ah, thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
"...I was hoping to try the lottery one 
more time before the period ended, but..."

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Seeing a hamburger steak that looks this 
good, I'm worried I won't be able to hold 
back my cravings again...!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Awawa... My mouth is watering so much... 
Trainer, u-um, about that hamburger 
steak...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I ended up yielding the prize to Kawakami 
Princess, whose eyes were completely glued 
to the hamburger steak.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Second prize~!! The prize is a "Mountain 
of Carrots"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Oh my, second prize?!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
L-Look at that! All those carrots packed 
into that cardboard box!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
It's a world of difference from tissues! 
Could we not call this practically a 
victory!?
choice_data_list:
Has your memory of the raffle been 
overwritten?

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Yes, of course!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I shared a massive pile of carrots with an 
overjoyed Kawakami Princess.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text: 3rd prize~! The prize is "one carrot"!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Saafe...! Somehow I managed to avoid the 
tissues.

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
Ehe, leave it to me. I too grow day by 
day!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: ...Even if it's only little by little!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Having safely avoided the tissue, Kawakami 
Princess seemed in a slightly better mood.

text_block_list.name: Shopping District Local
text_block_list.text:
Too bad, you lost! Your consolation prize 
is a pack of tissues~

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Acquired "<itemname>".

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: Waaaah, I knew it would be like this~!

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text: "No, Trainer is not at fault!"

text_block_list.name: Kawakami Princess
text_block_list.text:
It's all because Princess Right Hand is 
filled with such worldly desires! Curse 
you, right hand! Curse youuu...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I kept encouraging Kawakami Princess, who 
was completely down in the dumps.
